prs.title: fix(client): preserve authorization server subpath in fallback URLs
prs.author: claygeo
prs.reason: [llm pick] cluster primary for issue #1716: Both PRs have unknown CI status (tie). #1832 touches 2 files vs. #1724's 3 files, making it the smaller, more focused diff. On approach: #1724 resolves the issue by throwing an error when a non-root AS path is detected — a fail-fast guard that rejects previously-accepted inputs and could break existing deployments. #1832 instead preserves the subpath when constructing the fallback URL, which is a direct fix to the URL-building logic and maintains backward compatibility for clients already using non-root AS paths. Fixing the construction is more correct than making the case an error. On age alone #1724 would win, but diff size and approach correctness favor #1832.
